note: Hard-skill taxonomy for twenty careers (fourteen technical and business roles plus six business roles added in v4). Soft and managerial skills are out of scope because they cannot be assessed with multiple-choice questions and no course teaches them like a tool or a method.

skills.name: SQL & Kueri Basis Data
skills.description: Menulis kueri SQL untuk mengambil, menggabungkan, dan meringkas data dari basis data relasional.
skills.learn_what: kueri dasar hingga agregasi: SELECT-WHERE, JOIN, GROUP BY-HAVING, subquery
skills.description_en: Write SQL queries to retrieve, join, and summarise data from relational databases.
skills.learn_what_en: basic queries to aggregation: SELECT-WHERE, JOIN, GROUP BY-HAVING, subqueries

skills.name: Statistika
skills.description: Memakai statistika deskriptif dan inferensial (sebaran, korelasi, uji hipotesis, regresi) untuk menarik kesimpulan dari data.
skills.learn_what: statistika deskriptif, sebaran data, korelasi, uji hipotesis, regresi sederhana
skills.description_en: Use descriptive and inferential statistics (distributions, correlation, hypothesis tests, regression) to draw conclusions from data.
skills.learn_what_en: descriptive statistics, distributions, correlation, hypothesis testing, simple regression

skills.name: Analisis Data
skills.description: Mengolah dan menafsirkan data untuk menemukan pola, menjawab pertanyaan bisnis, dan merumuskan insight.
skills.learn_what: alur analisis dari pertanyaan bisnis, eksplorasi data, segmentasi, hingga perumusan insight
skills.description_en: Process and interpret data to find patterns, answer business questions, and form insights.
skills.learn_what_en: the analysis flow from business question and data exploration to segmentation and insight

skills.name: Visualisasi Data
skills.description: Memilih dan membuat grafik yang tepat agar data mudah dipahami pengambil keputusan.
skills.learn_what: jenis grafik, prinsip desain visual, menghindari grafik menyesatkan, visual untuk KPI
skills.description_en: Choose and build the right charts so decision-makers understand the data quickly.
skills.learn_what_en: chart types, visual design principles, avoiding misleading charts, visuals for KPIs

skills.name: Pelaporan & Dashboard BI
skills.description: Merancang laporan berkala dan dashboard business intelligence yang memantau kinerja bisnis.
skills.learn_what: desain dashboard, laporan berkala, otomasi pelaporan, pemilihan metrik per audiens
skills.description_en: Design recurring reports and business intelligence dashboards that track business performance.
skills.learn_what_en: dashboard design, recurring reports, report automation, choosing metrics per audience

skills.name: Persiapan & Kualitas Data
skills.description: Membersihkan, memvalidasi, dan menyiapkan data agar akurat dan siap dianalisis.
skills.learn_what: menangani data hilang dan duplikat, validasi, standardisasi format, kriteria kualitas data
skills.description_en: Clean, validate, and prepare data so it is accurate and ready for analysis.
skills.learn_what_en: handling missing and duplicate data, validation, standardising formats, data quality criteria

skills.name: Pemodelan Data & Basis Data
skills.description: Memahami struktur basis data relasional dan memodelkan data (ERD, kamus data, pemetaan data).
skills.learn_what: konsep basis data relasional, ERD, normalisasi, star schema, data mapping dan kamus data
skills.description_en: Understand relational database structure and model data (ERDs, data dictionaries, data mapping).
skills.learn_what_en: relational database concepts, ERDs, normalisation, star schema, data mapping and dictionaries

skills.name: Python/R untuk Analisis
skills.description: Memakai Python (pandas) atau R untuk mengolah dan menganalisis data dalam skala lebih besar.
skills.learn_what: dasar Python, pandas untuk manipulasi data, notebook, visualisasi dengan matplotlib/seaborn
skills.description_en: Use Python (pandas) or R to process and analyse data at a larger scale.
skills.learn_what_en: Python basics, pandas for data manipulation, notebooks, plotting with matplotlib/seaborn

skills.name: Metrik & KPI Bisnis
skills.description: Merumuskan, menghitung, dan memantau indikator kinerja yang mencerminkan tujuan bisnis.
skills.learn_what: jenis metrik, pohon metrik, KPI vs OKR, metrik funnel dan retensi
skills.description_en: Define, calculate, and monitor performance indicators that reflect business goals.
skills.learn_what_en: types of metrics, metric trees, KPIs vs OKRs, funnel and retention metrics

skills.name: Analisis Keuangan
skills.description: Membaca laporan keuangan dan menganalisis kinerja finansial, anggaran, dan profitabilitas.
skills.learn_what: membaca laporan laba rugi dan neraca, rasio keuangan, anggaran, analisis profitabilitas
esco: analyse financial performance of a company
skills.description_en: Read financial statements and analyse financial performance, budgets, and profitability.
skills.learn_what_en: reading income statements and balance sheets, financial ratios, budgeting, profitability analysis

skills.name: Elisitasi Kebutuhan
skills.description: Menggali kebutuhan bisnis dan pengguna melalui wawancara, workshop, dan observasi.
skills.learn_what: teknik wawancara, workshop kebutuhan, observasi, memilah kebutuhan bisnis vs pengguna
esco: interact with users to gather requirements
skills.description_en: Uncover business and user needs through interviews, workshops, and observation.
skills.learn_what_en: interview techniques, requirements workshops, observation, separating business from user needs

skills.name: Dokumentasi Kebutuhan (BRD/FSD/User Story)
skills.description: Menuangkan kebutuhan ke dokumen yang dapat ditindaklanjuti tim teknis: BRD, FSD, user story, acceptance criteria.
skills.learn_what: struktur BRD/FSD, user story dan acceptance criteria, spesifikasi fungsional, traceability
skills.description_en: Turn requirements into documents the technical team can act on: BRDs, FSDs, user stories, acceptance criteria.
skills.learn_what_en: BRD/FSD structure, user stories and acceptance criteria, functional specs, traceability

skills.name: Pemodelan Proses Bisnis (BPMN/Flowchart)
skills.description: Memetakan alur proses bisnis saat ini dan usulan (as-is/to-be) dengan flowchart atau BPMN.
skills.learn_what: notasi flowchart dan BPMN, swimlane, pemetaan as-is dan to-be
skills.description_en: Map current and proposed (as-is/to-be) business processes with flowcharts or BPMN.
skills.learn_what_en: flowchart and BPMN notation, swimlanes, as-is and to-be mapping

skills.name: Pemodelan Sistem (UML/Use Case)
skills.description: Memodelkan perilaku dan struktur sistem dengan diagram UML seperti use case, activity, dan sequence.
skills.learn_what: use case diagram dan skenario, activity diagram, sequence diagram, DFD
esco: translate requirement concepts into visual design
skills.description_en: Model system behaviour and structure with UML diagrams such as use case, activity, and sequence diagrams.
skills.learn_what_en: use case diagrams and scenarios, activity diagrams, sequence diagrams, DFDs

skills.name: Siklus Pengembangan Sistem (SDLC)
skills.description: Memahami tahapan pengembangan perangkat lunak dan peran analis di setiap tahap.
skills.learn_what: tahapan SDLC, waterfall vs iteratif, peran BA di setiap tahap, manajemen change request
skills.description_en: Understand the stages of software development and the analyst's role in each.
skills.learn_what_en: SDLC stages, waterfall vs iterative, the BA's role at each stage, managing change requests

skills.name: Pengujian Sistem & UAT
skills.description: Menyusun skenario dan test case serta mengoordinasikan user acceptance test.
skills.learn_what: skenario dan test case, UAT, pelacakan defect, pengujian berbasis acceptance criteria
skills.description_en: Write test scenarios and cases, and coordinate user acceptance testing.
skills.learn_what_en: test scenarios and cases, UAT, defect tracking, testing against acceptance criteria

skills.name: Microsoft Excel & Spreadsheet
skills.description: Mengolah data dengan spreadsheet: rumus, lookup, pivot table, dan grafik.
skills.learn_what: rumus dan referensi sel, lookup (VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP), pivot table, grafik dasar
skills.description_en: Work with data in spreadsheets: formulas, lookups, pivot tables, and charts.
skills.learn_what_en: formulas and cell references, lookups (VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP), pivot tables, basic charts

skills.name: Power BI
skills.description: Membangun model data dan dashboard interaktif di Microsoft Power BI.
skills.learn_what: impor dan transformasi data, relasi model, DAX dasar, publikasi dashboard
skills.description_en: Build data models and interactive dashboards in Microsoft Power BI.
skills.learn_what_en: importing and transforming data, model relationships, basic DAX, publishing dashboards

skills.name: Tableau
skills.description: Membuat visualisasi dan dashboard interaktif di Tableau.
skills.learn_what: koneksi data, dimensi vs measure, calculated field, dashboard dan story
skills.description_en: Create interactive visualisations and dashboards in Tableau.
skills.learn_what_en: data connections, dimensions vs measures, calculated fields, dashboards and stories

skills.name: Looker/Metabase & BI Lain
skills.description: Memakai alat BI berbasis SQL dan web seperti Looker Studio, Looker, Metabase, atau Superset.
skills.learn_what: menyambungkan sumber data, membuat chart berbasis SQL, berbagi dashboard
skills.description_en: Use SQL-based web BI tools such as Looker Studio, Looker, Metabase, or Superset.
skills.learn_what_en: connecting data sources, building SQL-based charts, sharing dashboards

skills.name: Jira/Confluence & Alat Kolaborasi
skills.name_en: Jira, Confluence and work tracking tools
skills.description: Mengelola backlog, tiket, dan dokumentasi tim dengan Jira, Confluence, atau alat sejenis.
skills.learn_what: issue dan workflow Jira, board scrum/kanban, halaman dokumentasi Confluence
skills.description_en: Manage backlogs, tickets, and team documentation with Jira, Confluence, or similar tools.
skills.learn_what_en: Jira issues and workflows, scrum/kanban boards, Confluence documentation pages

skills.name: Alat Diagram (Visio/Lucidchart/draw.io)
skills.description: Menggambar diagram proses dan sistem dengan alat seperti Visio, Lucidchart, draw.io, atau Miro.
skills.learn_what: membuat flowchart/BPMN rapi, template, kolaborasi diagram
skills.description_en: Draw process and system diagrams with tools such as Visio, Lucidchart, draw.io, or Miro.
skills.learn_what_en: clean flowcharts/BPMN, templates, collaborative diagramming

skills.name: Wireframe & Prototipe (Figma)
skills.description: Menerjemahkan kebutuhan menjadi wireframe atau mockup sederhana untuk divalidasi pengguna.
skills.learn_what: low-fidelity wireframe, alur layar, prototipe klik di Figma
esco: translate requirement concepts into visual design
skills.description_en: Turn requirements into simple wireframes or mockups that users can validate.
skills.learn_what_en: low-fidelity wireframes, screen flows, clickable prototypes in Figma

skills.name: Sistem ERP & CRM
skills.description: Memahami modul dan alur sistem enterprise seperti SAP, Oracle, Odoo, Dynamics, atau Salesforce.
skills.learn_what: konsep modul ERP (finance, procurement, inventory), alur order-to-cash, CRM dasar
skills.description_en: Understand the modules and flows of enterprise systems such as SAP, Oracle, Odoo, Dynamics, or Salesforce.
skills.learn_what_en: ERP module concepts (finance, procurement, inventory), order-to-cash flow, CRM basics

skills.name: Platform Data Cloud (BigQuery dsb.)
skills.description: Mengakses dan mengolah data di gudang data cloud seperti BigQuery, Snowflake, atau Redshift.
skills.learn_what: konsep data warehouse cloud, kueri di BigQuery, biaya kueri, berbagi dataset
skills.description_en: Access and process data in cloud data warehouses such as BigQuery, Snowflake, or Redshift.
skills.learn_what_en: cloud data warehouse concepts, querying in BigQuery, query cost, sharing datasets

skills.name: API & Integrasi Sistem
skills.description: Memahami cara sistem bertukar data lewat API (REST, JSON/XML) dan merumuskan kebutuhan integrasi antarsistem.
skills.learn_what: konsep REST API, format JSON/XML, membaca spesifikasi API (Swagger/OpenAPI), alur integrasi
skills.description_en: Understand how systems exchange data through APIs (REST, JSON/XML) and specify integration requirements.
skills.learn_what_en: REST API concepts, JSON/XML formats, reading API specs (Swagger/OpenAPI), integration flows

skills.name: Matematika & statistika untuk machine learning
skills.description: Memakai aljabar linear, probabilitas, dan optimisasi yang menjadi dasar metode machine learning.
skills.learn_what: vektor dan matriks, distribusi probabilitas, nilai harapan dan varians, gradien, fungsi loss
skills.description_en: Use the linear algebra, probability and optimisation that machine-learning methods rest on.
skills.learn_what_en: vectors and matrices, probability distributions, expectation and variance, gradients, loss functions

skills.name: Machine learning (scikit-learn)
skills.description: Melatih, mengevaluasi, dan menyetel model machine learning klasik serta merancang fitur yang berguna.
skills.learn_what: pembagian data latih/uji dan cross-validation, klasifikasi dan regresi, ensemble pohon, metrik, rekayasa fitur
skills.description_en: Train, evaluate and tune classical machine-learning models and engineer useful features.
skills.learn_what_en: train/test split and cross-validation, classification and regression, tree ensembles, metrics, feature engineering

skills.name: Deep learning (TensorFlow & PyTorch)
skills.description: Membangun dan melatih jaringan saraf dengan TensorFlow atau PyTorch, termasuk alur kerja transformer dan LLM modern.
skills.learn_what: tensor dan autograd, loop pelatihan, CNN, model sekuens, transformer, fine-tuning dan prompting LLM
skills.description_en: Build and train neural networks with TensorFlow or PyTorch, including modern transformer and LLM workflows.
skills.learn_what_en: tensors and autograd, training loops, CNNs, sequence models, transformers, fine-tuning and prompting LLMs

skills.name: NLP & computer vision
skills.description: Menerapkan teknik bahasa dan citra: pipeline teks, embedding, deteksi, dan klasifikasi.
skills.learn_what: tokenisasi dan embedding, klasifikasi teks, OCR, prapemrosesan citra, deteksi objek
skills.description_en: Apply language and image techniques: text pipelines, embeddings, detection and classification.
skills.learn_what_en: tokenisation and embeddings, text classification, OCR, image preprocessing, object detection

skills.name: Deployment model & MLOps
skills.description: Merilis model ke produksi: serving, versioning, pemantauan, dan pipeline pelatihan ulang.
skills.learn_what: pengemasan dan serving model, pelacakan eksperimen, registry, pemantauan dan drift, pelatihan ulang otomatis
skills.description_en: Ship models to production: serving, versioning, monitoring and retraining pipelines.
skills.learn_what_en: model packaging and serving, experiment tracking, registries, monitoring and drift, automated retraining

skills.name: Pipeline ETL / ELT
skills.description: Memindahkan dan mengubah data antarsistem secara andal dengan pipeline ETL atau ELT.
skills.learn_what: pola extract-transform-load, incremental load, CDC, model dbt, pemeriksaan kualitas data
skills.description_en: Move and transform data reliably between systems with ETL or ELT pipelines.
skills.learn_what_en: extract-transform-load patterns, incremental loads, CDC, dbt models, data quality checks

skills.name: Data warehouse & pemodelan
skills.description: Memodelkan dan menjalankan penyimpanan analitik: star schema, warehouse, data lake, dan lakehouse.
skills.learn_what: pemodelan dimensional, slowly changing dimension, partisi, mesin warehouse, lake vs lakehouse
skills.description_en: Model and operate analytical stores: star schemas, warehouses, lakes and lakehouses.
skills.learn_what_en: dimensional modelling, slowly changing dimensions, partitioning, warehouse engines, lake vs lakehouse

skills.name: Pemrosesan big data (Spark & Hadoop)
skills.description: Memproses dataset besar secara paralel dengan Spark dan ekosistem Hadoop.
skills.learn_what: RDD dan DataFrame, Spark SQL, partisi dan shuffle, penyetelan job, dasar Hive dan HDFS
skills.description_en: Process large datasets in parallel with Spark and the Hadoop ecosystem.
skills.learn_what_en: RDDs and DataFrames, Spark SQL, partitioning and shuffles, tuning jobs, Hive and HDFS basics

skills.name: Orkestrasi alur kerja (Airflow)

skills.learn_what: DAG dan task, jadwal dan backfill, retry dan peringatan, sensor, deployment Airflow
skills.description_en: Schedule and monitor data workflows as DAGs with Airflow or a similar orchestrator.
skills.learn_what_en: DAGs and tasks, schedules and backfills, retries and alerts, sensors, deploying Airflow

skills.name: Data streaming (Kafka)
skills.description: Menerima dan memproses aliran event secara real time dengan Kafka dan stream processor.
skills.learn_what: topic, partisi, dan consumer group, semantik pengiriman, stream processing, schema registry
skills.description_en: Ingest and process event streams in real time with Kafka and stream processors.
skills.learn_what_en: topics, partitions and consumer groups, delivery semantics, stream processing, schema registry

skills.name: Linux & shell
skills.description: Mengoperasikan server Linux lewat baris perintah dan mengotomatiskan tugas dengan skrip shell.
skills.learn_what: sistem berkas dan izin, proses dan layanan, alat jaringan, SSH, skrip bash
skills.description_en: Operate Linux servers from the command line and automate tasks with shell scripts.
skills.learn_what_en: filesystem and permissions, processes and services, networking tools, SSH, bash scripting

skills.name: Dasar jaringan komputer
skills.description: Memahami cara jaringan memindahkan lalu lintas: TCP/IP, DNS, HTTP/TLS, routing, subnet, dan firewall.
skills.learn_what: OSI dan TCP/IP, pengalamatan IP dan subnetting, DNS dan DHCP, routing dan VLAN, TLS dan VPN
skills.description_en: Understand how networks move traffic: TCP/IP, DNS, HTTP/TLS, routing, subnets and firewalls.
skills.learn_what_en: OSI and TCP/IP, IP addressing and subnetting, DNS and DHCP, routing and VLANs, TLS and VPN

skills.name: Docker & container
skills.description: Mengemas dan menjalankan aplikasi dalam container dengan Docker dan Compose.
skills.learn_what: image dan layer, Dockerfile, volume dan network, Compose, registry, pengerasan image
skills.description_en: Package and run applications in containers with Docker and Compose.
skills.learn_what_en: images and layers, Dockerfile, volumes and networks, Compose, registries, image hardening

skills.description_en: Deploy and operate containerised workloads on Kubernetes.
skills.learn_what_en: pods, deployments and services, config and secrets, ingress, Helm, scaling and rollouts

skills.name: Pipeline CI/CD

skills.learn_what: tahap pipeline, caching dan artefak, secret, environment dan persetujuan, rollback
skills.description_en: Automate build, test and deployment with CI/CD pipelines.
skills.learn_what_en: pipeline stages, caching and artefacts, secrets, environments and approvals, rollbacks

skills.name: Infrastructure as code (Terraform & Ansible)

skills.description_en: Provision and configure infrastructure declaratively with Terraform and Ansible.

skills.description_en: Design and run workloads on AWS: compute, storage, networking, identity and managed services.

skills.description_en: Run workloads on Google Cloud or Azure: compute, storage, networking, identity and managed services.

skills.description_en: Serve and protect applications with Nginx, Apache or a reverse proxy, including TLS and caching.
